dict.string: TrailForge uses your GPS location to show your live 4WD position on offline topo maps, record trail breadcrumbs, and provide one-tap Backtrack return guidance.

TrailForge uses background location so your 4WD trip breadcrumbs keep recording accurately when your screen is locked in remote areas. Mandatory start/end privacy buffer trimming (>=250 m) is always enforced.
TrailForge reads motion and accelerometer sensors to display a live 4WD pitch/roll clinometer and measure trail corrugations and rock-step roughness.
